Class ShapeVec

Namespace
ShapeEngine.StaticLib
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Provides extension methods and utilities for working with Vector2 in 2D space. Includes vector math, geometric, and utility functions for game development.

ClassifyCorner(Vector2, Vector2, float)

Classifies the corner formed by two direction vectors.

public static (int type, float angle) ClassifyCorner(this Vector2 dirPrev, Vector2 dirNext, float epsilon = 1E-06)

Parameters

dirPrev Vector2

The previous (incoming) direction vector.

dirNext Vector2

The next (outgoing) direction vector.

epsilon float

Small tolerance used to treat vectors as colinear (default 1e-6).

Returns

(int type, float angle)

A tuple containing:

  • type: an integer where 0 = colinear, 1 = ccw outwards, -1 = ccw inwards.
  • angle: the absolute angle between the two directions in radians (range 0..π).

Remarks

The classification is determined using the 2D cross product and dot product:

  • If |cross| ≤ epsilon the vectors are considered colinear.
  • Otherwise the sign of cross determines inward/outward classification while the angle is computed with Atan2(|cross|, dot). Angle close to 0 indicates collinear in the same direction, angle close to π indicates collinear in opposite directions.

IsColinear(Vector2, Vector2, Vector2, float, bool)

Determines whether three points (a, b, c) are colinear within a given tolerance.

public static bool IsColinear(Vector2 a, Vector2 b, Vector2 c, float epsilon = 1E-06, bool scaledEpsilon = true)

Parameters

a Vector2

The first point.

b Vector2

The middle/vertex point.

c Vector2

The third point.

epsilon float

The tolerance used to consider the cross product effectively zero. Smaller values require closer alignment.

scaledEpsilon bool

If true, the epsilon is scaled by the geometric mean of the squared segment lengths to account for numerical precision when points are far apart or segment lengths vary greatly. If false, epsilon is used directly.

Returns

bool

True if the points are colinear or if any segment has zero length (coincident points); otherwise false.

IsColinear(Vector2, Vector2, float, bool)

Determines whether two direction vectors are colinear within a given tolerance.

public static bool IsColinear(Vector2 dir1, Vector2 dir2, float epsilon = 1E-06, bool scaledEpsilon = true)

Parameters

dir1 Vector2

The first direction vector.

dir2 Vector2

The second direction vector.

epsilon float

Tolerance used to consider the 2D cross product effectively zero. Smaller values require closer alignment.

scaledEpsilon bool

If true, the epsilon is scaled by the geometric mean of the squared lengths of the vectors to account for numerical precision when magnitudes differ or are large; if false, epsilon is used directly.

Returns

bool

True if the vectors are colinear or if either vector has zero length (treated as coincident); otherwise false.

Remarks

Uses the 2D cross product and optional scaling to robustly handle floating point error for vectors of varying magnitude.

IsCollinearFromRawAngleDeg(float, float)

Determines whether a raw angle in degrees corresponds to a collinear orientation. The input rawAngleDeg is normalized into the canonical [-180, 180] range using NormalizeAngleDeg(float) and then checked against the provided tolerance:

  • near 0 degrees (same direction), or
  • near 180 / -180 degrees (opposite direction).
public static bool IsCollinearFromRawAngleDeg(float rawAngleDeg, float thresholdDeg = 0.001)

Parameters

rawAngleDeg float

Angle in degrees (any value).

thresholdDeg float

Tolerance in degrees to consider the angle collinear (default 1e-3f).

Returns

bool

True if the normalized angle is within thresholdDeg of 0 or 180 degrees.

IsCollinearFromRawAngleRad(float, float)

Determines whether a raw angle in radians corresponds to a collinear orientation. The input rawAngleRad is normalized into the canonical [-π, π] range using NormalizeAngleRad(float) and then checked against the provided tolerance:

  • near 0 radians (same direction), or
  • near π / -π radians (opposite direction).
public static bool IsCollinearFromRawAngleRad(float rawAngleRad, float thresholdRad = 0.001)

Parameters

rawAngleRad float

Angle in radians (any value).

thresholdRad float

Returns

bool

True if the normalized angle is within thresholdRad of 0 or π radians.
